name: Colt
overview: The colt holds significant Christ-centered symbolism as the young donkey upon which Jesus rode into Jerusalem, fulfilling prophecy and demonstrating His humility and kingly authority. The Gospels record Jesus instructing His disciples to find a colt tied alongside an ass, emphasizing that the colt had never been ridden before, signifying a unique and purposeful selection for this moment (Matthew 21:2; Mark 11:2). This event fulfilled the prophetic declaration that the King would come meekly, sitting on both an ass and a colt, highlighting the Messiah's peaceful and humble nature as He entered the city (Matthew 21:5; John 12:15). The colt's role underscores Jesus’ fulfillment of Old Testament prophecy and His identity as the prophesied King who comes in humility to bring salvation.
